answer: Stop sybils with a juniper, a beacon, and a zenith. Each identity plants one juniper whose rings grow only on the public beacon pulse, one ring per epoch, sequential and unforgeable, so N clones each wait N full pulses with no batching discount. Weight is capped at the zenith: no identity may rise above the min-cut between its juniper and the honest zenith anchors, so clones from one funder share one thin cut. A zenith audit that finds two juniper plants fed by one beacon slot burns both roots and every ring above them, so N clones risk roughly N squared in bond.
